variants.change_description: Fresh control: BF16 embeddings, batch 16, region window 64 and dynamic pages.

outcome_note.summary: The fresh eager control passed all 30 calls at p50 3.31 s, reproducing the previous 3.29 s result.
outcome_note.next: NACA spends 14.2% in embedding. Compare compiled embeddings; the linked Census study also motivates speculation for its long OCR decode.

variants.change_description: From the concurrency-eight winner: compile only the BF16 embedding forward with dynamic shapes.

outcome_note.summary: Compiled embeddings improved p50 from 3.31 to 3.15 s; p95 reached 25.30 s and throughput 26.67 pages/min. All 30 calls passed.
outcome_note.next: Attention profiling shows 90.7% OCR and 5.9% embedding; Census has one long OCR decode. Test GPU n-gram speculation and inspect proposal acceptance alongside all three evaluator metrics.
